q1_issues.issue: (Patient sk_lose_1 us10yt_rr) puts a TRANSITIVE subject in Patient; the change-of-state-undergoer test is for intransitive subjects only, and a transitive subject stays Agent (or Holder for a possession verb) even when inanimate and non-volitional.
The direct object "11/32" gets no role at all — it is folded into a Measure on the event instead of filling the verb's object slot, so the clause has a verb with no object.
(Fraction 11 32) sits in the Measure magnitude slot, but Fraction is defined only as a ProportionOf level; a magnitude is a native number or a ParticleFromNormal distribution.
The unit `point` is not in the text — "lost 11/32 in price" states a scale (price) but no unit, so `point` is supplied from bond-market world knowledge.

(Member us10yt_rr benchmark) exposes a NOUN modifier as a property of the referent; the instruction set says a noun modifier is never exposed (the "can it be predicated of the thing?" test fails for "benchmark"), and only the genus of a fused compound is emitted.
"late on Monday" is attached to the losing event, but it modifies the FROM value ("from 3.17 percent late on Monday") — the prior yield level is what Monday dates, not the loss being reported.

(Time sk_lose_1 late) invents `late` as a bare Time symbol; the licensed bare Time symbols are deictics and the day-parts morning/afternoon/evening/night, and `late` is a degree modifier on a time rather than a time.

(Measure us10yt_rr duration 10 year) reads the attributive compound "10-year note" as a duration of the note itself; `duration` is the scale for an eventuality's extent, and no dimension word is stated here to license any scale.

The new and old yield levels are emitted as two independent measures with no ordering or change relation between them, so "taking its yield TO 3.21 FROM 3.17" loses the movement it states; the "taking" participial clause is also dropped entirely.

q2_gaps: numeric attributive compounds ("10-year note", "three-day meeting") — the compound rules handle adjective and noun modifiers but not a number+unit modifier, and no measure scale is stated to hang it on

a free participial adjunct on a clause ("..., taking its yield to X from Y") — the instruction set covers participial post-modifiers on a NOUN (reduced relatives) but not a participial clause modifying the whole matrix clause
change in a measured value ("lost 11/32 in price", "to 3.21 percent from 3.17 percent") — no form encodes one entity's value moving by a delta from one level to another
a fractional magnitude as a measured amount ("11/32") — Fraction exists only as a ProportionOf level, and magnitudes are native numbers
notes: No head is invented — every operator used is defined — but the losing clause is structurally wrong on three counts at once (subject role, missing object, Fraction-as-magnitude) and the from/to yield movement is flattened into two unrelated measures. The name symbol and Name string for US10YT=RR are handled correctly.
